articles.title: Medtronic Antitrust Verdict Raises Questions Around Valuation And Future Risks
articles.mainIdea: Medtronic Antitrust Verdict Raises Questions Around Valuation And Future Risks
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Medtronic Antitrust Verdict Raises Questions Around Valuation And Future Risks. Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) has been found liable for violating U.S. antitrust laws in the advanced bipolar devices market. A federal jury awarded more than US$381m in damages to Applied Medical in the case. The verdict centers on alleged anticompetitive practices affecting surgical device competition.
